visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female staff member wearing a white t-shirt, a yellow apron, a face mask, and a baseball cap is busy behind the counter of a modern beverage shop. She is seen pouring tea from a large silver kettle into stainless steel containers while another person stands partially obscured nearby. The setting is bright with indoor lighting, featuring light wood paneling and round white pendant lights hanging from the ceiling. A stack of yellow paper cups with a character illustration is positioned in the foreground on the white countertop. (2) The camera shifts to extreme close-ups of the drink preparation process. A hand is seen using a large metal ladle to scoop translucent, red-tinted honey jelly and amber-colored tea from a large stainless steel vat. The lighting highlights the glistening texture of the jelly. This is followed by a shot of four finished cups of tea, each a different shade of red, gold, and milky white, all displaying the same red-hatted character logo. (3) More close-up shots show the assembly of various specialty drinks. Milk is poured into a cup filled with ice cubes and dark brown sugar jelly, creating a swirling visual effect as it mixes with the dark liquid. Another scene shows a scoop of thick brown sugar jelly being lifted with a spoon, and later, a dark red liquid is poured over a cup overflowing with ice. Three dark dried plums and one green plum are carefully placed on top of a tea beverage using metal tongs. (4) The scene transitions to a wide shot of the shop's interior, showing a digital POS display and posters on the wall featuring different tea products. The female staff member is still working in the background. Finally, the scene cuts to an outdoor shot of the storefront on a bright, sunny day. The large yellow sign reads 'HUHUCHA TEASHOP' in both Chinese and English, featuring the character logo. Several scooters are parked on the sidewalk in front of the shop's modern facade.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator with an energetic, high-arousal tone introduces the tea shop in Traditional Chinese. The voice is friendly and professional, layered over an upbeat pop background track with a prominent electronic beat. A clear splashing sound marks the pouring of liquid, emphasizing the artisanal nature of the beverages. The audio mix is clean, with the voice positioned centrally over a rhythmic musical bed. (2) As the narrator describes the 'chewy' ingredients like peony black tea and honey jelly, his pitch variability remains high to maintain audience engagement. The background music maintains a steady tempo, while incidental sounds of metal clinking against stainless steel (likely scoops and vats) provide a grounded, realistic atmosphere to the otherwise stylized production. (3) The narration shifts to describing milk tea and brown sugar jelly. The vocal delivery is fast-paced but clear, synchronized with the rhythmic beat of the music. Sound effects of ice cubes shifting and more liquid pouring are interwoven with the speech, creating a multi-layered acoustic experience that mirrors the visual complexity of the drink preparation. (4) In the final phase, the narrator provides the shop's address and a closing catchphrase. The music continues with a cheerful instrumental bridge as the narrator's volume remains dominant. A subtle whoosh sound effect facilitates the transition to the final information slide. The overall production quality is high, resembling a professional social media food vlog or promotional video.
